body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids fold & make printable: Kindness Card 01.

A simple folded kindness card: lay the paper flat, fold it in half, and decorate the front. Delivery note: this set is 20 variants of one simple card fold and is marked REVIEW REQUIRED — please fold-test it before classroom use.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet, follow the numbered steps in order, and press every fold flat with the side of your hand. Open the card and write or draw a kind message inside.

takeaway: Folding paper in order — and giving the finished card away — practices patience, sequencing and kindness in one small make.
materials: A printer and paper (slightly thicker paper or card stock is nicest)
Stickers or drawings for the front (optional)
supervision: Do the first fold together and let them press the crease — a well-pressed fold is the secret to a neat card.
safetyNotes: Paper edges can nip fingertips — fold slowly and press with the flat of the hand, not a fingernail.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Deliver the card to its person today — by hand, by post box, or under a pillow — and notice how giving feels.
